messages:
mina: Support ping - customer saw invoices charge the impersonated SA's project when CI jobs used impersonation. They expected billing to stay with their org.
zheng: Today our billing follows the effective identity (the impersonated SA). That's historically simpler for quota enforcement but surprises customers.
ara: Product asks: can we offer a consent flow so org admins opt in to billing-by-impersonator vs billing-by-effective-identity?
mina: That could work. Prefer default = current behavior, opt-in flag per org for billing_to_impersonator. Need telemetry first.
zheng: Implementation sketch: routing emits trace attrs: impersonation=true, impersonator_id, impersonated_id, cross_org=true|false. Billing decision uses FF `billing_mode` (effective|impersonator).
ara: UX: console toggle in org billing settings with help text and a link to "Audit impersonation" view. Also need an admin approval audit log when toggled.
mina: Ops concerns: if org flips mode retroactively, billing exports need to stay immutable. Any changes apply forward only. Finance must sign off.
zheng: I'll add telemetry and a FF to gate billing change. Plan: dark launch telemetry 24h -> FF for 1% orgs -> expand after finance + legal review.
ara: Add a small API to preview impact: `GET /orgs/:org/billing/impersonation_preview` returns projected delta for last 7 days. Useful for finance.
ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-5234: "impersonation billing mode feature flag + telemetry + preview API" assigned to zheng/ara.
mina: Owners noted. Sync tomorrow 10:30 to review telemetry sample.
zheng: Will add unit tests and a BQ export column `impersonation_mode` to avoid breaking consumers.
mina: Thanks, closing for now.
